articles.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
articles.snippet: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

articles.title: Bybit will look for big broker partnerships to take on Robinhood in the U.S.
articles.snippet: When it comes to the U.S., Bybit will look to work with with someone like Interactive Brokers (IB), for example, said CEO Ben Zhou.

articles.title: PHP Foundation admits ‘structural failure’ delayed critical security fix
articles.snippet: Government websites and online services were disrupted after concerns about a PHP bug that could allow attackers to take control of vulnerable servers.

articles.title: PHP Panic: Two Critical Bugs Put 70% of the Internet at Risk, and Everyone Is Freaking Out
articles.snippet: Two critical bugs in PHP, the language running most of the web, let strangers take over servers without a password. The patch is out, attacks started early, and governments pulled the plug.

articles.title: OpenAI Buys Orchestra Bio to Put AI Agents in Charge of Drug Development Grunt Work
articles.snippet: The ChatGPT maker is folding Orchestra’s drug-program agents into Rosalind, its life sciences suite, betting AI can shave time off the decade-plus it takes to bring a medicine to patients.
